scripts.postinstall: node -e "try { const fs=require('fs'); const p='node_modules/rollup/dist/native.js'; if(fs.existsSync(p)){ let c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); if(!c.includes('@rollup/wasm-node')){ c=c.replace('const nativeModule = requireWithFriendlyError', 'let nativeModule; try { nativeModule = requireWithFriendlyError'); c=c.replace(');', '); } catch(e){ nativeModule = require(\'@rollup/wasm-node/dist/native.js\'); }'); fs.writeFileSync(p, c); } } } catch(e){}"
